title: auth
summary: Benilla defines the realmd login-protocol-v3 wire: logon challenge (game/platform/OS/locale tags, account), challenge reply (SRP6 inputs + crc_salt + security-flag/PIN consumption), logon proof, proof reply, realm-list request/response. MSUI's RealmClient.cs is a faithful port of all five shapes (same constants, same PIN-block skip, same stream-alignment reads) backed by Srp6Client.cs.
